keys.label: OFFSET_GROUND_LOAD
keys.causal_role: asymmetrical load stores forward travel and roll bias before release
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root settles down-left over rear support; torso and arms oppose intended bank

keys.label: CANTED_SUPPORT_BREAK
keys.causal_role: rear support releases into a canted launch rather than a symmetric jump
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root accelerates forward/up; existing roll bias carries into flight without a later second impulse

keys.label: OPEN_RISE
keys.causal_role: airborne body opens into a broad asymmetric lift silhouette while root continues one launch arc
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root climbs forward; left arm opens wider/lower than right to keep attitude specific

keys.label: ONE_SIDE_TUCK_BANK
keys.causal_role: one side tucks early, committing body attitude while root still rises
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root rises with decreasing vertical gain; torso banks left as left arm folds and right remains open

keys.label: STALL_APEX
keys.causal_role: brief one-sided stall owns the apex silhouette; no hover and no relaunch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root reaches a brief apex with forward drift intact; body bank deepens while one side remains folded

keys.label: KNIFE_DROP
keys.causal_role: gravity earns a steeper descent while bank remains visibly unresolved
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root descends sharply with smaller forward increment; no control motion injects upward root travel

keys.label: LEAD_SIDE_FLARE
keys.causal_role: the previously folded side opens first, beginning attitude recovery while descent continues
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root keeps descending/right; left arm snaps wide while right stays partly swept, making flare staggered

keys.label: FULL_FLARE_PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: second side opens after the first; torso levels and legs scissor before ground contact
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root remains on a downward/forward path while body attitude recovers and lead foot drops under COM

keys.label: LEAD_TOE_STRIKE
keys.causal_role: first contact takes vertical load without arresting forward travel or attitude debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: left toe catches while root still moves down/right; torso pitches past the contact instead of freezing

keys.label: CROSS_STEP_RUNOUT
keys.causal_role: support transfers forward to pay lateral/roll debt with a real runout step
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root travels forward and slightly lower; right foot crosses under while left releases, torso overshoots

keys.label: TWO_FOOT_BRAKE_CRUSH
keys.causal_role: deep grounded compression pays remaining vertical/forward debt and stores rebound
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root reaches its lowest grounded point after both feet join; arms trail unequally behind braking body

keys.label: BRAKE_REBOUND_LAG
keys.causal_role: root rebounds while the long-side arm lags, preventing reverse-play recovery
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root rises modestly at a new address; torso opens opposite compression and right arm remains late

keys.label: DISPLACED_FLIGHT_EXIT
keys.causal_role: readiness returns with residual asymmetry at a displaced location instead of idle reset
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root settles forward of landing; arms remain unequal and torso carries a slight forward cant
